'''2026 Tatooine Regionals Paul Coggins DS endor operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Coggins]] at [[2026 Regional Championships]] (Tatooine).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Paul Coggins]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Tatooine
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
